2) It is now  time to create the storyboard. A storyboard is a selection of simple sketches for each of the illustrations of the story. It gives us a better idea about the visual images of the children’s story.

4) Meanwhile, the composer creates the melody. Both the story itself and the artist’s illustrations serve as inspiration for the creation of music. 5) What’s more, we also translate our stories for kids into other languages.

6) But that’s not the end! It’s important to see how the book for kids looks inside the app. Line breaks should be checked to make sure the text looks nice and neat. This is done by two professionals: the programmer and the tester.

Some advanced features are covered by Bookshelf Pro subscription plans.

ORGANIZE YOUR BOOKS
- Catalog books using fast and easy to use ISBN barcode scanner
- Batch scanner option allows to rapidly scan multiple books at once
- Books can be added using search functionality (title/author/ISBN)
- Old and rare books can be added manually
- Import books from a CSV file generated by other popular book apps
- Import books from Goodreads

CREATE SHELVES AND TAGS
- Organize books by creating virtual bookshelves and tags
- Use search functionality to quickly find books on your shelves
- Sort your books by title, author, number of pages, publication date, etc.
- Use filters to display books matching your criteria
- Track your lent and borrowed books
- Add information about your book purchases
- Organize books by series and volumes
- Create personal notes or add other useful information
- Add quotes by simply scanning the text with our OCR reader
- Multiple book selection; apply batch operations
- Grid view available
- Dark theme available

SET CUSTOM READING GOALS
- Create annual reading goals to stay motivated
- Define custom date range goals and share them with your friends

TRACK YOUR READING
- Log how many pages you have read so far and when did you start and finished reading a book
- You can record multiple readings for each book

SEE WHAT YOUR FRIENDS ARE READING
- Create your own reading social profile
- Allow your followers to see your last read books, wishlist and reading goals

DISCOVER NEW BOOKS
- Discover bestselling books in different categories
- Share your favorite books with your friends on social media

VIEW YOUR STATISTICS
- Rich statistics about your books, purchase, reading progress, ratings, top authors, top categories etc.

MANAGE YOUR WISHLIST
- Maintain a wishlist of books that you want to read
- Book price tracking and price alerts available in some countries

RATE AND REVIEW
- Help others to discover great books and find books for yourself
- Rate books with 5 star rating (half-star ratings available)
- Read book reviews from others and leave your own opinion

NEVER LOSE YOUR DATA
- Your data is securely stored on our servers and it's linked to your account
- If you change your device/platform, you just need to log back in with your username
- You can export data to a CSV file to create your own backup
- You can export your data as HTML web page for easy printing with cover images

BOOKSHELF PRO PLANS
- Bookshelf is free to download and use
- There is no limit on number of books and all essential features are free
- Some advanced features are covered by Bookshelf Pro subscription plans
- Bookshelf Pro includes a 7-day free trial period after which you can choose between monthly, annual or lifetime plans

OTHER NOTES
- This is an app to organize your books and to track your reading
- Reading is not available within this app
